import scipy.sparse as sp
import numpy as np

# Create a sparse matrix
data = np.array([1, 2, 3])
row = np.array([0, 1, 2])
col = np.array([0, 1, 2])
matrix = sp.csr_matrix((data, (row, col)), shape=(3, 3))

# Use the new API: .T.conj()
result = matrix.T.conj()

before_snippet:
import scipy.sparse as sp
import numpy as np

# Create a sparse matrix
data = np.array([1, 2, 3])
row = np.array([0, 1, 2])
col = np.array([0, 1, 2])
matrix = sp.csr_matrix((data, (row, col)), shape=(3, 3))

# This API existed in 1.15.3
result = sp.conjtransp(matrix)
assert result is not None
title: scipy.sparse.conjtransp removed - use .T.conj() instead
